summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint for transforming CAgenix into an institutional-grade Indian financial operating system. Converts currency to Indian Rupee (₹) with Lakh/Crore notation, implements GST (CGST/SGST/IGST) and TDS compliance (194C, 194J, 194Q), and connects domestic banking and gateway rails (Razorpay, UPI, HDFC, ICICI, Cashfree) while preserving the Executive Precision design aesthetic.
